description.value:
Trigger You throw a Graft.

Cost 1 Vitae

The Graft’s splash affects every creature within 10 feet of the target instead of only those adjacent to it. Any creature that takes splash damage this way is off-guard to you until the end of your next turn.

cinderfall.incomplete: Splash radius is not exposed as a rule-element-modifiable field on a consumable item, so nothing widens it to 10 ft or off-guards creatures hit by it.
